+import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
+import createSmallptModule from "../wasm/smallpt.js";
+
+interface SmallptWasmModule {
+  _render: (w: number, h: number, samps: number) => number;
+  _render_rows: (w: number, h: number, samps: number, startY: number, endY: number) => void;
+  _init_framebuffer: (w: number, h: number) => number;
+  _get_framebuffer: () => number;
+  _randomize_sphere_colors: (seed: number) => void;
+  _reset_sphere_colors: () => void;
+  _set_sphere_color: (index: number, r: number, g: number, b: number) => void;
+  _get_sphere_color_r: (index: number) => number;
+  _get_sphere_color_g: (index: number) => number;
+  _get_sphere_color_b: (index: number) => number;
+  _get_sphere_count: () => number;
+  HEAPU8: Uint8Array;
+}
+
+interface SphereColorInfo {
+  index: number;
+  name: string;
+  r: number;
+  g: number;
+  b: number;
+  hex: string;
+}
+
+const SPHERE_LABELS: { index: number; name: string }[] = [
+  { index: 0, name: "Left Wall" },
+  { index: 1, name: "Right Wall" },
+  { index: 2, name: "Back Wall" },
+  { index: 4, name: "Floor" },
+  { index: 5, name: "Ceiling" },
+  { index: 6, name: "Mirror Sphere" },
+  { index: 7, name: "Glass Sphere" },
+];
+
+const RENDER_WIDTH = 240;
+const RENDER_HEIGHT = 180;
+const RENDER_SAMPLES = 1; // 4 subpixel samples per pixel
+
+function toHexChannel(val: number): string {
+  const srgb = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, Math.floor(Math.pow(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, val)), 1 / 2.2) * 255 + 0.5)));
+  return srgb.toString(16).padStart(2, "0");
+}
+
+function readSphereColors(mod: SmallptWasmModule): SphereColorInfo[] {
+  return SPHERE_LABELS.map(({ index, name }) => {
+    const r = mod._get_sphere_color_r(index);
+    const g = mod._get_sphere_color_g(index);
+    const b = mod._get_sphere_color_b(index);
+    const hex = `#${toHexChannel(r)}${toHexChannel(g)}${toHexChannel(b)}`;
+    return { index, name, r, g, b, hex };
+  });
+}
+
+export default function SmallptPathTracer() {
+  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);
+  const wasmRef = useRef<SmallptWasmModule | null>(null);
+  const wasmPromiseRef = useRef<Promise<SmallptWasmModule> | null>(null);
+  const seedCounterRef = useRef<number>(1);
+
+  const [status, setStatus] = useState<string>("Loading WebAssembly module...");
+  const [renderTimeMs, setRenderTimeMs] = useState<number | null>(null);
+  const [renderCount, setRenderCount] = useState<number>(0);
+  const [sphereColors, setSphereColors] = useState<SphereColorInfo[]>([
+    { index: 0, name: "Left Wall", r: 0.75, g: 0.25, b: 0.25, hex: "#dd8888" },
+    { index: 1, name: "Right Wall", r: 0.25, g: 0.25, b: 0.75, hex: "#8888dd" },
+    { index: 2, name: "Back Wall", r: 0.75, g: 0.75, b: 0.75, hex: "#dddddd" },
+    { index: 4, name: "Floor", r: 0.75, g: 0.75, b: 0.75, hex: "#dddddd" },
+    { index: 5, name: "Ceiling", r: 0.75, g: 0.75, b: 0.75, hex: "#dddddd" },
+    { index: 6, name: "Mirror Sphere", r: 0.999, g: 0.999, b: 0.999, hex: "#ffffff" },
+    { index: 7, name: "Glass Sphere", r: 0.999, g: 0.999, b: 0.999, hex: "#ffffff" },
+  ]);
+
+  const executeRender = (mod: SmallptWasmModule, randomize: boolean) => {
+    const t0 = performance.now();
+    if (randomize) {
+      const nextCount = seedCounterRef.current++;
+      const randomPart = Math.floor(Math.random() * 0x7fffffff);
+      const seed = ((randomPart ^ (nextCount * 2654435761)) >>> 0) || nextCount;
+      mod._randomize_sphere_colors(seed);
+    }
+
+    const ptr = mod._render(RENDER_WIDTH, RENDER_HEIGHT, RENDER_SAMPLES);
+    const byteLength = RENDER_WIDTH * RENDER_HEIGHT * 4;
+    const pixels = new Uint8ClampedArray(
+      mod.HEAPU8.buffer,
+      ptr,
+      byteLength
+    );
+
+    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
+    if (canvas) {
+      const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
+      if (ctx) {
+        const imageData = new ImageData(new Uint8ClampedArray(pixels), RENDER_WIDTH, RENDER_HEIGHT);
+        ctx.putImageData(imageData, 0, 0);
+      }
+    }
+
+    const elapsed = Math.round(performance.now() - t0);
+    const updatedColors = readSphereColors(mod);
+    setSphereColors(updatedColors);
+    setRenderTimeMs(elapsed);
+    setRenderCount((prev) => prev + 1);
+    setStatus(
+      randomize
+        ? `Rendered with randomized sphere colors in ${elapsed} ms`
+        : `Rendered initial scene in ${elapsed} ms`
+    );
+  };
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    let cancelled = false;
+    const baseUrl = import.meta.env.BASE_URL || "/devtools-times/";
+    const normalizedBase = baseUrl.endsWith("/") ? baseUrl : `${baseUrl}/`;
+
+    const initPromise = (createSmallptModule({
+      locateFile: (path: string) => `${normalizedBase}wasm/${path}`,
+    }) as Promise<SmallptWasmModule>).then((mod) => {
+      wasmRef.current = mod;
+      if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
+        (window as unknown as Record<string, unknown>).smallptWasm = mod;
+      }
+      if (!cancelled) {
+        executeRender(mod, false);
+      }
+      return mod;
+    });
+
+    wasmPromiseRef.current = initPromise;
+
+    initPromise.catch((err) => {
+      console.error("Failed to initialize smallpt WebAssembly module:", err);
+      if (!cancelled) {
+        setStatus("Error loading WebAssembly module");
+      }
+    });
+
+    return () => {
+      cancelled = true;
+    };
+  }, []);
+
+  const handleRandomizeClick = async () => {
+    let mod = wasmRef.current;
+    if (!mod && wasmPromiseRef.current) {
+      mod = await wasmPromiseRef.current;
+    }
+    if (mod) {
+      executeRender(mod, true);
+    }
+  };
+
+  return (
+    <section
+      id="smallpt-section"
+      data-testid="smallpt-section"
+      className="bg-slate-900 text-white rounded-lg shadow-md border border-slate-700 p-5 my-4"
+    >
+      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center gap-6">
+        <div className="flex-shrink-0 flex flex-col items-center">
+          <canvas
+            ref={canvasRef}
+            id="smallpt-canvas"
+            data-testid="smallpt-canvas"
+            data-rendered={renderCount > 0 ? "true" : "false"}
+            data-render-count={renderCount}
+            width={RENDER_WIDTH}
+            height={RENDER_HEIGHT}
+            className="w-[360px] h-[270px] bg-black rounded border border-slate-600 shadow-inner"
+          />
+          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-2 font-mono" data-testid="smallpt-status">
+            {status}
+            {renderTimeMs !== null ? ` (Run #${renderCount})` : ""}
+          </p>
+        </div>
+
+        <div className="flex-1 space-y-4">
+          <div>
+            <span className="inline-block bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40 text-xs font-semibold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded mb-2">
+              Interactive WebAssembly Demo
+            </span>
+            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-white">
+              smallpt C++ Path Tracer (WebAssembly)
+            </h2>
+            <p className="text-sm text-slate-300 mt-1">
+              Kevin Beason's open-source C++ global illumination path tracer compiled to WebAssembly and running client-side in your browser.
+            </p>
+          </div>
+
+          <div>
+            <h3 className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 mb-2">
+              Scene Sphere Colors
+            </h3>
+            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2" data-testid="sphere-colors-grid">
+              {sphereColors.map((sphere) => (
+                <div
+                  key={sphere.index}
+                  className="flex items-center space-x-2 bg-slate-800/80 border border-slate-700 rounded px-2.5 py-1.5"
+                >
+                  <span
+                    className="w-4 h-4 rounded-full border border-white/30 flex-shrink-0"
+                    style={{ backgroundColor: sphere.hex }}
+                  />
+                  <div className="min-w-0">
+                    <div className="text-xs font-medium text-slate-200 truncate">
+                      {sphere.name}
+                    </div>
+                    <div className="text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-400">
+                      {sphere.hex}
+                    </div>
+                  </div>
+                </div>
+              ))}
+            </div>
+          </div>
+
+          <div className="pt-1">
+            <button
+              id="randomize-sphere-colors-btn"
+              data-testid="randomize-sphere-colors-btn"
+              type="button"
+              onClick={handleRandomizeClick}
+              className="bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-400 active:bg-amber-600 text-slate-950 font-semibold text-sm px-4 py-2.5 rounded shadow transition cursor-pointer"
+            >
+              Run Again with Randomized Sphere Colors
+            </button>
+          </div>
+        </div>
+      </div>
+    </section>
+  );
+}

+#include <math.h>   // smallpt, a Path Tracer by Kevin Beason, 2008
+#include <stdlib.h> // Make : g++ -O3 -fopenmp smallpt.cpp -o smallpt
+#include <stdio.h>  //        Remove "-fopenmp" for g++ version < 4.2
+#include <stdint.h>
+#ifdef __EMSCRIPTEN__
+#include <emscripten/emscripten.h>
+#else
+#define EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE
+#endif
+
+struct Vec {        // Usage: time ./smallpt 5000 && xv image.ppm
+  double x, y, z;                  // position, also color (r,g,b)
+  Vec(double x_=0, double y_=0, double z_=0){ x=x_; y=y_; z=z_; }
+  Vec operator+(const Vec &b) const { return Vec(x+b.x,y+b.y,z+b.z); }
+  Vec operator-(const Vec &b) const { return Vec(x-b.x,y-b.y,z-b.z); }
+  Vec operator*(double b) const { return Vec(x*b,y*b,z*b); }
+  Vec mult(const Vec &b) const { return Vec(x*b.x,y*b.y,z*b.z); }
+  Vec& norm(){ return *this = *this * (1/sqrt(x*x+y*y+z*z)); }
+  double dot(const Vec &b) const { return x*b.x+y*b.y+z*b.z; } // cross:
+  Vec operator%(Vec&b){return Vec(y*b.z-z*b.y,z*b.x-x*b.z,x*b.y-y*b.x);}
+};
+struct Ray { Vec o, d; Ray(Vec o_, Vec d_) : o(o_), d(d_) {} };
+enum Refl_t { DIFF, SPEC, REFR };  // material types, used in radiance()
+struct Sphere {
+  double rad;       // radius
+  Vec p, e, c;      // position, emission, color
+  Refl_t refl;      // reflection type (DIFFuse, SPECular, REFRactive)
+  Sphere(double rad_, Vec p_, Vec e_, Vec c_, Refl_t refl_):
+    rad(rad_), p(p_), e(e_), c(c_), refl(refl_) {}
+  double intersect(const Ray &r) const { // returns distance, 0 if nohit
+    Vec op = p-r.o; // Solve t^2*d.d + 2*t*(o-p).d + (o-p).(o-p)-R^2 = 0
+    double t, eps=1e-4, b=op.dot(r.d), det=b*b-op.dot(op)+rad*rad;
+    if (det<0) return 0; else det=sqrt(det);
+    return (t=b-det)>eps ? t : ((t=b+det)>eps ? t : 0);
+  }
+};
+Sphere spheres[] = {//Scene: radius, position, emission, color, material
+  Sphere(1e5, Vec( 1e5+1,40.8,81.6), Vec(),Vec(.75,.25,.25),DIFF),//Left
+  Sphere(1e5, Vec(-1e5+99,40.8,81.6),Vec(),Vec(.25,.25,.75),DIFF),//Rght
+  Sphere(1e5, Vec(50,40.8, 1e5),     Vec(),Vec(.75,.75,.75),DIFF),//Back
+  Sphere(1e5, Vec(50,40.8,-1e5+170), Vec(),Vec(),           DIFF),//Frnt
+  Sphere(1e5, Vec(50, 1e5, 81.6),    Vec(),Vec(.75,.75,.75),DIFF),//Botm
+  Sphere(1e5, Vec(50,-1e5+81.6,81.6),Vec(),Vec(.75,.75,.75),DIFF),//Top
+  Sphere(16.5,Vec(27,16.5,47),       Vec(),Vec(1,1,1)*.999, SPEC),//Mirr
+  Sphere(16.5,Vec(73,16.5,78),       Vec(),Vec(1,1,1)*.999, REFR),//Glas
+  Sphere(600, Vec(50,681.6-.27,81.6),Vec(12,12,12),  Vec(), DIFF) //Lite
+};
+inline double clamp(double x){ return x<0 ? 0 : x>1 ? 1 : x; }
+inline int toInt(double x){ return int(pow(clamp(x),1/2.2)*255+.5); }
+inline bool intersect(const Ray &r, double &t, int &id){
+  double n=sizeof(spheres)/sizeof(Sphere), d, inf=t=1e20;
+  for(int i=int(n);i--;) if((d=spheres[i].intersect(r))&&d<t){t=d;id=i;}
+  return t<inf;
+}
+Vec radiance(const Ray &r, int depth, unsigned short *Xi, int E=1){
+  double t;                               // distance to intersection
+  int id=0;                               // id of intersected object
+  if (!intersect(r, t, id)) return Vec(); // if miss, return black
+  const Sphere &obj = spheres[id];        // the hit object
+  Vec x=r.o+r.d*t, n=(x-obj.p).norm(), nl=n.dot(r.d)<0?n:n*-1, f=obj.c;
+  double p = f.x>f.y && f.x>f.z ? f.x : f.y>f.z ? f.y : f.z; // max refl
+  if (++depth>5||!p) {
+    if (depth>20 || erand48(Xi)>=p) return obj.e*E; // R.R.
+    f=f*(1/p);
+  }
+  if (obj.refl == DIFF){                  // Ideal DIFFUSE reflection
+    double r1=2*M_PI*erand48(Xi), r2=erand48(Xi), r2s=sqrt(r2);
+    Vec w=nl, u=((fabs(w.x)>.1?Vec(0,1):Vec(1))%w).norm(), v=w%u;
+    Vec d = (u*cos(r1)*r2s + v*sin(r1)*r2s + w*sqrt(1-r2)).norm();
+
+    // Explicit light sampling of ceiling area light (spheres[8])
+    Vec e;
+    const Sphere &light = spheres[8];
+    double u1 = erand48(Xi), u2 = erand48(Xi);
+    double r_disk = 17.5 * sqrt(u1), phi = 2 * M_PI * u2;
+    double ly = light.p.y - sqrt(light.rad * light.rad - r_disk * r_disk);
+    Vec lp(light.p.x + r_disk * cos(phi), ly, light.p.z + r_disk * sin(phi));
+    Vec to_light = lp - x;
+    double dist2 = to_light.dot(to_light);
+    Vec l = to_light * (1.0 / sqrt(dist2));
+    double cos_surface = l.dot(nl);
+    double cos_light = l.y;
+    if (cos_surface > 0 && cos_light > 0) {
+      double lt;
+      int lid = 0;
+      if (intersect(Ray(x, l), lt, lid) && lid == 8) {
+        double omega = (M_PI * 18.0 * 18.0 * cos_light) / dist2;
+        e = f.mult(light.e * (cos_surface * omega * M_1_PI));
+      }
+    }
+    return obj.e*E + e + f.mult(radiance(Ray(x,d),depth,Xi,0));
+  } else if (obj.refl == SPEC)            // Ideal SPECULAR reflection
+    return obj.e + f.mult(radiance(Ray(x,r.d-n*2*n.dot(r.d)),depth,Xi,1));
+  Ray reflRay(x, r.d-n*2*n.dot(r.d));     // Ideal dielectric REFRACTION
+  bool into = n.dot(nl)>0;                // Ray from outside going in?
+  double nc=1, nt=1.5, nnt=into?nc/nt:nt/nc, ddn=r.d.dot(nl), cos2t;
+  if ((cos2t=1-nnt*nnt*(1-ddn*ddn))<0)    // Total internal reflection
+    return obj.e + f.mult(radiance(reflRay,depth,Xi,1));
+  Vec tdir = (r.d*nnt - n*((into?1:-1)*(ddn*nnt+sqrt(cos2t)))).norm();
+  double a=nt-nc, b=nt+nc, R0=a*a/(b*b), c = 1-(into?-ddn:tdir.dot(n));
+  double Re=R0+(1-R0)*c*c*c*c*c,Tr=1-Re,P=.25+.5*Re,RP=Re/P,TP=Tr/(1-P);
+  return obj.e + f.mult(depth>2 ? (erand48(Xi)<P ?   // Russian roulette

+    radiance(reflRay,depth,Xi,1)*Re+radiance(Ray(x,tdir),depth,Xi,1)*Tr);
+}
+
+static uint8_t *rgba_buffer = nullptr;
+static Vec *accum_buffer = nullptr;
+static int buf_w = 0;
+static int buf_h = 0;
+
+extern "C" {
+
+EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE
+int get_sphere_count() {
+  return sizeof(spheres) / sizeof(Sphere);
+}
+
+EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE
+void set_sphere_color(int index, double r, double g, double b) {
+  int n = get_sphere_count();
+  if (index >= 0 && index < n) {
+    spheres[index].c = Vec(clamp(r), clamp(g), clamp(b));
+  }
+}
+
+EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE
+double get_sphere_color_r(int index) {
+  int n = get_sphere_count();
+  return (index >= 0 && index < n) ? spheres[index].c.x : 0.0;
+}
+
+EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE
+double get_sphere_color_g(int index) {
+  int n = get_sphere_count();
+  return (index >= 0 && index < n) ? spheres[index].c.y : 0.0;
+}
+
+EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE
+double get_sphere_color_b(int index) {
+  int n = get_sphere_count();
+  return (index >= 0 && index < n) ? spheres[index].c.z : 0.0;
+}
+
+EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE
+void reset_sphere_colors() {
+  spheres[0].c = Vec(.75, .25, .25);
+  spheres[1].c = Vec(.25, .25, .75);
+  spheres[2].c = Vec(.75, .75, .75);
+  spheres[3].c = Vec(0, 0, 0);
+  spheres[4].c = Vec(.75, .75, .75);
+  spheres[5].c = Vec(.75, .75, .75);
+  spheres[6].c = Vec(1, 1, 1) * .999;
+  spheres[7].c = Vec(1, 1, 1) * .999;
+  spheres[8].c = Vec(0, 0, 0);
+}
+
+static Vec hsv_to_rgb(double h, double s, double v) {
+  int i = int(h);
+  double f = h - i;
+  double p = v * (1.0 - s);
+  double q = v * (1.0 - s * f);
+  double t = v * (1.0 - s * (1.0 - f));
+  switch (i % 6) {
+    case 0: return Vec(v, t, p);
+    case 1: return Vec(q, v, p);
+    case 2: return Vec(p, v, t);
+    case 3: return Vec(p, q, v);
+    case 4: return Vec(t, p, v);
+    default: return Vec(v, p, q);
+  }
+}
+
+EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE
+void randomize_sphere_colors(unsigned int seed) {
+  unsigned short Xi[3] = {
+    (unsigned short)((seed ^ 0x5DEECE66DULL) & 0xFFFF),
+    (unsigned short)(((seed >> 16) ^ 0xB504F333ULL) & 0xFFFF),
+    (unsigned short)(((seed * 48271U) + 11U) & 0xFFFF)

+    int idx = colored_indices[k];

+    double h = fmod(base_hue + k * 3.7082039 + erand48(Xi) * 0.7, 6.0);

+      // Keep mirror and glass spheres bright & vividly tinted
+      double s = 0.55 + 0.40 * erand48(Xi);
+      spheres[idx].c = hsv_to_rgb(h, s, 0.999);
+    } else {
+      double s = 0.65 + 0.30 * erand48(Xi);
+      double v = 0.72 + 0.23 * erand48(Xi);

+EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE
+uint8_t* init_framebuffer(int w, int h) {
+  if (w != buf_w || h != buf_h || !rgba_buffer || !accum_buffer) {
+    delete[] rgba_buffer;
+    delete[] accum_buffer;
+    buf_w = w;
+    buf_h = h;
+    rgba_buffer = new uint8_t[w * h * 4];
+    accum_buffer = new Vec[w * h];
+  }
+  for (int i = 0; i < w * h; i++) {
+    accum_buffer[i] = Vec();
+    rgba_buffer[i * 4 + 0] = 0;
+    rgba_buffer[i * 4 + 1] = 0;
+    rgba_buffer[i * 4 + 2] = 0;
+    rgba_buffer[i * 4 + 3] = 255;
+  }
+  return rgba_buffer;
+}
+
+EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE
+uint8_t* get_framebuffer() {
+  return rgba_buffer;
+}
+
+EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE
+void render_rows(int w, int h, int samps, int start_y, int end_y) {
+  if (w != buf_w || h != buf_h || !rgba_buffer || !accum_buffer) {
+    init_framebuffer(w, h);
+  }
+  if (samps < 1) samps = 1;
+  if (start_y < 0) start_y = 0;
+  if (end_y > h) end_y = h;
+
+  Ray cam(Vec(50,52,295.6), Vec(0,-0.042612,-1).norm()); // cam pos, dir
+  Vec cx=Vec(w*.5135/h), cy=(cx%cam.d).norm()*.5135, r;
+
+  for (int y=start_y; y<end_y; y++){               // Loop over image rows
+    for (unsigned short x=0, Xi[3]={0,0,(unsigned short)(y*y*y)}; x<w; x++) // Loop cols
+      for (int sy=0, i=(h-y-1)*w+x; sy<2; sy++)     // 2x2 subpixel rows
+        for (int sx=0; sx<2; sx++, r=Vec()){        // 2x2 subpixel cols
+          for (int s=0; s<samps; s++){
+            double r1=2*erand48(Xi), dx=r1<1 ? sqrt(r1)-1: 1-sqrt(2-r1);
+            double r2=2*erand48(Xi), dy=r2<1 ? sqrt(r2)-1: 1-sqrt(2-r2);

+                    cy*( ( (sy+.5 + dy)/2 + y)/h - .5) + cam.d;
+            r = r + radiance(Ray(cam.o+d*140,d.norm()),0,Xi)*(1./samps);
+          }
+          accum_buffer[i] = accum_buffer[i] + Vec(clamp(r.x),clamp(r.y),clamp(r.z))*.25;
+        }
+    for (int x=0; x<w; x++) {
+      int i = (h-y-1)*w+x;
+      rgba_buffer[i*4 + 0] = (uint8_t)toInt(accum_buffer[i].x);
+      rgba_buffer[i*4 + 1] = (uint8_t)toInt(accum_buffer[i].y);
+      rgba_buffer[i*4 + 2] = (uint8_t)toInt(accum_buffer[i].z);
+      rgba_buffer[i*4 + 3] = 255;
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+EMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE
+uint8_t* render(int w, int h, int samps) {
+  init_framebuffer(w, h);
+  render_rows(w, h, samps, 0, h);
+  return rgba_buffer;
+}
+
+} // extern "C"
+
+int main(int argc, char *argv[]){
+  int w=256, h=192, samps = argc==2 ? atoi(argv[1])/4 : 1; // # samples
+  if (samps < 1) samps = 1;
+  render(w, h, samps);
+  FILE *f = fopen("image.ppm", "w");         // Write image to PPM file.
+  if (f) {
+    fprintf(f, "P3\n%d %d\n%d\n", w, h, 255);
+    for (int i=0; i<w*h; i++)
+      fprintf(f,"%d %d %d ", rgba_buffer[i*4+0], rgba_buffer[i*4+1], rgba_buffer[i*4+2]);
+    fclose(f);
+  }
+  return 0;
+}

+  saveDb(initial);
+  return initial;
+}
+
+export function saveDb(db) {
+  try {
+    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(db));
+  } catch (e) {
+    console.warn('Storage write warning:', e);
+  }
+}
+
+export function getActiveUser() {
+  const db = loadDb();
+  if (!db.signedInUserId) return null;
+  return db.users.find((u) => u.id === db.signedInUserId) || null;
+}
+
+function jsonResponse(data, status = 200) {
+  return new Response(JSON.stringify(data), {
+    status,
+    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+  });
+}
+
+// Endpoint handlers used by both api.js helpers and window.fetch interceptor
+export async function handleApiRequest(path, method = 'GET', bodyObj = {}) {
+  const db = loadDb();
+  const activeUser = db.users.find((u) => u.id === db.signedInUserId) || db.users[0];
+
+  // 1. Registration Options: POST /api/register/options
+  if (path === '/api/register/options' && (method === 'POST' || method === 'GET')) {
+    // Allow registration for existing signed-in user or a newly registering customer
+    let targetUser = activeUser;
+    if (bodyObj && bodyObj.name) {
+      let existing = db.users.find((u) => u.name.toLowerCase() === bodyObj.name.toLowerCase());
+      if (!existing) {
+        const newUserId = generateRandomBase64Url(16);
+        existing = {
+          id: newUserId,
+          passkeyUserId: newUserId,
+          name: bodyObj.name.trim(),
+          displayName: (bodyObj.displayName || bodyObj.name.split('@')[0]).trim(),
+          password: bodyObj.password || '',
+          favoriteRoast: bodyObj.favoriteRoast || 'Maple Oat Latte',
+          defaultLocation: 'Downtown Roastery & Reserve Bar',
+          rewardsPoints: 150,
+        };
+        db.users.push(existing);
+      } else if (bodyObj.displayName) {
+        existing.displayName = bodyObj.displayName.trim();
+      }
+      db.signedInUserId = existing.id;
+      targetUser = existing;
+    }
+
+    const challenge = generateRandomBase64Url(32);
+    const isPromotionFlow = Boolean(bodyObj?.promotion || bodyObj?.conditional);
+    const userExistingCredentials = db.credentials.filter(
+      (c) => c.passkeyUserId === targetUser.passkeyUserId
+    );
+
+    const options = {
+      challenge,
+      rp: { id: RP_ID, name: RP_NAME },
+      user: {
+        id: targetUser.passkeyUserId,
+        name: targetUser.name,
+        displayName: targetUser.displayName,
+      },
+      pubKeyCredParams: [
+        { type: 'public-key', alg: -7 },
+        { type: 'public-key', alg: -257 },
+      ],
+      excludeCredentials: userExistingCredentials.map((cred) => ({
+        type: 'public-key',
+        id: cred.id,
+        transports: cred.transports || ['internal', 'hybrid'],
+      })),
+      authenticatorSelection: {
+        residentKey: 'required',
+        requireResidentKey: true,
+        userVerification: 'preferred',
+        ...(isPromotionFlow && { authenticatorAttachment: 'platform' }),
+      },
+    };
+
+    db.session.challenge = challenge;
+    db.session.expectedUserVerification = 'preferred';
+    db.session.isConditionalCreate = Boolean(bodyObj?.conditional);
+    saveDb(db);
+    return jsonResponse(options, 200);
+  }
+
+  // 2. Registration Verify: POST /api/register/verify
+  if (path === '/api/register/verify' && method === 'POST') {
+    const credId = bodyObj?.id;
+    if (!credId || !isValidBase64Url(credId)) {
+      return jsonResponse({ error: 'Invalid credential ID format.' }, 400);
+    }
+
+    // Verify challenge & user presence (relaxing UP only for conditional create, relaxing UV for preferred)
+    const requireUserVerification = db.session.expectedUserVerification === 'required';
+    const requireUserPresence = !db.session.isConditionalCreate;
+
+    const aaguid = extractAaguidFromAttestation(bodyObj);
+    const meta = resolveAaguidMetadata(aaguid);
+    const now = Date.now();
+
+    const newCred = {
+      id: credId,
+      passkeyUserId: activeUser.passkeyUserId,
+      credentialPublicKey:
+        bodyObj?.response?.attestationObject || generateRandomBase64Url(48),
+      credentialType: 'public-key',
+      credentialDeviceType: 'multiDevice',
+      credentialBackedUp: true,
+      aaguid: meta.aaguid,
+      providerIcon: meta.providerIcon || DEFAULT_FALLBACK_ICON,
+      name: bodyObj?.nickname || meta.name || 'Passkey',
+      transports: bodyObj?.response?.transports || ['internal', 'hybrid'],
+      registeredAt: now,
+      lastUsedAt: now,
+      counter: 0,
+    };
+
+    const existingIdx = db.credentials.findIndex((c) => c.id === credId);
+    if (existingIdx >= 0) {
+      db.credentials[existingIdx] = newCred;
+    } else {
+      db.credentials.push(newCred);
+    }
+    db.signedInUserId = activeUser.id;
+    saveDb(db);
+
+    return jsonResponse({
+      verified: true,
+      requireUserVerification,
+      requireUserPresence,
+      rpId: RP_ID,
+      userId: activeUser.passkeyUserId,
+      credential: newCred,
+      user: activeUser,
+    });
+  }
+
+  // 3. Authentication Options (Discoverable): POST /api/login/options
+  if (path === '/api/login/options' && (method === 'POST' || method === 'GET')) {
+    const challenge = generateRandomBase64Url(32);
+    const options = {
+      challenge,
+      rpId: RP_ID,
+      allowCredentials: [], // Discoverable credentials
+      userVerification: 'preferred',
+    };
+    db.session.challenge = challenge;
+    db.session.expectedUserVerification = 'preferred';
+    saveDb(db);
+    return jsonResponse(options, 200);
+  }
+
+  // 4. Authentication Verify: POST /api/login/verify
+  if (path === '/api/login/verify' && method === 'POST') {
+    const credId = bodyObj?.id;
+    const storedCred = db.credentials.find((c) => c.id === credId);
+    if (!storedCred) {
+      // Clean Server Error 404 so client triggers PublicKeyCredential.signalUnknownCredential
+      return jsonResponse({ error: 'Credential not found', rpId: RP_ID }, 404);
+    }
+    const user =
+      db.users.find((u) => u.passkeyUserId === storedCred.passkeyUserId) || db.users[0];
+    storedCred.lastUsedAt = Date.now();
+    storedCred.counter = (storedCred.counter || 0) + 1;
+    db.signedInUserId = user.id;
+    saveDb(db);
+    return jsonResponse({
+      verified: true,
+      rpId: RP_ID,
+      userId: user.passkeyUserId,
+      user,
+      credential: storedCred,
+    });
+  }
+
+  // 5. Password Sign-In / Sign-Up: POST /api/login/password & POST /api/register/account
+  if (path === '/api/login/password' && method === 'POST') {
+    const username = (bodyObj?.username || bodyObj?.email || '').trim();
+    if (!username) {
+      return jsonResponse({ error: 'Username is required' }, 400);
+    }
+    let user = db.users.find((u) => u.name.toLowerCase() === username.toLowerCase());
+    if (!user) {
+      const newUserId = generateRandomBase64Url(16);
+      user = {
+        id: newUserId,
+        passkeyUserId: newUserId,
+        name: username,
+        displayName: bodyObj?.displayName || username.split('@')[0] || 'Coffee Lover',
+        password: bodyObj?.password || '',
+        favoriteRoast: 'Maple Oat Latte',
+        defaultLocation: 'Downtown Roastery & Reserve Bar',
+        rewardsPoints: 250,
+      };
+      db.users.push(user);
+    }
+    db.signedInUserId = user.id;
+    saveDb(db);
+    return jsonResponse({
+      verified: true,
+      rpId: RP_ID,
+      userId: user.passkeyUserId,
+      user,
+    });
+  }
+
+  // 6. Reauthentication Options (Constrained to signed-in user's credentials): POST /api/reauth/options
+  if (path === '/api/reauth/options' && (method === 'POST' || method === 'GET')) {
+    const userPasskeys = db.credentials.filter(
+      (c) => c.passkeyUserId === activeUser.passkeyUserId
+    );
+    const challenge = generateRandomBase64Url(32);
+    const options = {
+      challenge,
+      rpId: RP_ID,
+      userVerification: 'preferred',
+      allowCredentials: userPasskeys.map((cred) => ({
+        type: 'public-key',
+        id: cred.id,
+        transports: cred.transports || ['internal', 'hybrid'],
+      })),
+    };
+    db.session.challenge = challenge;
+    db.session.expectedUserVerification = 'preferred';
+    saveDb(db);
+    return jsonResponse(options, 200);
+  }
+
+  // 7. Reauthentication Verify: POST /api/reauth/verify
+  if (path === '/api/reauth/verify' && method === 'POST') {
+    const credId = bodyObj?.id;
+    const storedCredential = db.credentials.find((c) => c.id === credId);
+    if (!storedCredential) {
+      return jsonResponse({ error: 'Credential not found', rpId: RP_ID }, 404);
+    }
+    // Verify Account Ownership strictly matches active signed-in user
+    if (storedCredential.passkeyUserId !== activeUser.passkeyUserId) {
+      return jsonResponse(
+        { error: 'Credential does not belong to the active signed-in user.' },
+        403
+      );
+    }
+    storedCredential.lastUsedAt = Date.now();
+    storedCredential.counter = (storedCredential.counter || 0) + 1;
+    db.session.reauthenticatedAt = Date.now();
+    saveDb(db);
+    return jsonResponse({
+      verified: true,
+      rpId: RP_ID,
+      userId: activeUser.passkeyUserId,
+      reauthenticatedAt: db.session.reauthenticatedAt,
+    });
+  }
+
+  // 8. List Credentials: GET /api/credentials
+  if (path === '/api/credentials' && method === 'GET') {
+    const credentials = db.credentials
+      .filter((c) => c.passkeyUserId === activeUser.passkeyUserId)
+      .map((c) => {
+        const meta = resolveAaguidMetadata(c.aaguid);
+        return {
+          ...c,
+          providerIcon: c.providerIcon || meta.providerIcon || DEFAULT_FALLBACK_ICON,
+          name: c.name || meta.name,
+        };
+      });
+    return jsonResponse({
+      rpId: RP_ID,
+      userId: activeUser.passkeyUserId,
+      user: activeUser,
+      credentials,
+    });
+  }
+
+  // 9. Rename Credential: PUT /api/credential/:id
+  if (path.startsWith('/api/credential/') && method === 'PUT') {
+    const id = decodeURIComponent(path.replace('/api/credential/', ''));
+    const cred = db.credentials.find((c) => c.id === id);
+    if (!cred || cred.passkeyUserId !== activeUser.passkeyUserId) {
+      return jsonResponse({ error: 'Credential not found.' }, 404);
+    }
+    if (bodyObj && typeof bodyObj.name === 'string' && bodyObj.name.trim()) {
+      cred.name = bodyObj.name.trim();
+      saveDb(db);
+    }
+    return jsonResponse(cred, 200);
+  }
+
+  // 10. Delete Credential: DELETE /api/credential/:id
+  if (path.startsWith('/api/credential/') && method === 'DELETE') {
+    const id = decodeURIComponent(path.replace('/api/credential/', ''));
+    const idx = db.credentials.findIndex(
+      (c) => c.id === id && c.passkeyUserId === activeUser.passkeyUserId
+    );
+    if (idx === -1) {
+      return jsonResponse({ error: 'Credential not found.' }, 404);
+    }
+    db.credentials.splice(idx, 1);
+    saveDb(db);
+    return jsonResponse({ success: true, rpId: RP_ID, userId: activeUser.passkeyUserId }, 200);
+  }
+
+  // 11. Update User Account Details: PUT /api/user
+  if (path === '/api/user' && method === 'PUT') {
+    if (typeof bodyObj?.name === 'string' && bodyObj.name.trim()) {
+      activeUser.name = bodyObj.name.trim();
+    }
+    if (typeof bodyObj?.displayName === 'string' && bodyObj.displayName.trim()) {
+      activeUser.displayName = bodyObj.displayName.trim();
+    }
+    if (typeof bodyObj?.favoriteRoast === 'string') {
+      activeUser.favoriteRoast = bodyObj.favoriteRoast;
+    }
+    if (typeof bodyObj?.defaultLocation === 'string') {
+      activeUser.defaultLocation = bodyObj.defaultLocation;
+    }
+    saveDb(db);
+    return jsonResponse({
+      ...activeUser,
+      rpId: RP_ID,
+      userId: activeUser.passkeyUserId,
+    });
+  }
+
+  // 12. Logout: POST /api/logout
+  if (path === '/api/logout' && method === 'POST') {
+    db.signedInUserId = null;
+    db.session.reauthenticatedAt = null;
+    saveDb(db);
+    return jsonResponse({ success: true });
+  }
+
+  return null;
+}
+
+// Install transparent window.fetch interceptor for /api/* routes so static server works seamlessly
+if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.fetch && !window.__dailyGrindApiInstalled) {
+  window.__dailyGrindApiInstalled = true;
+  const originalFetch = window.fetch.bind(window);
+  window.fetch = async function (input, init = {}) {
+    try {
+      const urlStr = typeof input === 'string' ? input : input instanceof URL ? input.href : input?.url || '';
+      const parsedUrl = new URL(urlStr, window.location.origin);
+      if (parsedUrl.pathname.startsWith('/api/')) {
+        const method = (init.method || (typeof input === 'object' && input.method) || 'GET').toUpperCase();
+        let bodyObj = {};
+        if (init.body && typeof init.body === 'string') {
+          try {
+            bodyObj = JSON.parse(init.body);
+          } catch {
+            bodyObj = {};
+          }
+        }
+        const intercepted = await handleApiRequest(parsedUrl.pathname, method, bodyObj);
+        if (intercepted) return intercepted;
+      }
+    } catch (e) {
+      console.warn('API router fallback:', e);
+    }
+    return originalFetch(input, init);
+  };

+    }

+export async function loadManagementPanel() {
+  const response = await listFetch();
+  const { rpId, userId, credentials, user } = await response.json();
+
+  renderUI(credentials, user);
+  // Sync accepted credentials on initial load using server-provided rpId and userId
+  await syncAcceptedCredentials(rpId, userId, credentials);
+}
+
+// Delete a passkey and synchronize remaining credential IDs via signalAllAcceptedCredentials
+export async function performDelete(credentialId) {
+  const response = await deleteFetch(credentialId);
+  if (response.ok) {
+    const updatedResponse = await listFetch();
+    const { rpId, userId, credentials, user } = await updatedResponse.json();
+
+    renderUI(credentials, user);
+    // Sync remaining accepted credentials after deletion
+    await syncAcceptedCredentials(rpId, userId, credentials);
+    announceStatus(
+      'Passkey removed from your Daily Grind account and synced with your password manager.',
+      'info'
+    );
+  }
+}
+
+// Rename a passkey's nickname (updates server record only; does NOT invoke signalCurrentUserDetails)
+export async function performCredentialRename(credentialId, newCredentialName) {
+  const response = await renameCredentialFetch(credentialId, {
+    name: newCredentialName,
+  });
+  if (response.ok) {
+    const updatedResponse = await listFetch();
+    const { credentials, user } = await updatedResponse.json();
+    renderUI(credentials, user);
+    announceStatus(`Passkey renamed to "${newCredentialName}".`, 'success');
+  }
+}
+
+// Update user's account username (name) or displayName and synchronize via signalCurrentUserDetails
+export async function performUserRename(updatedName, updatedDisplayName, extraFields = {}) {
+  const response = await updateUserFetch({
+    name: updatedName,
+    displayName: updatedDisplayName,
+    ...extraFields,
+  });
+  if (response.ok) {
+    const updatedData = await response.json();
+    const { rpId, userId } = updatedData;
+
+    if (window.PublicKeyCredential && PublicKeyCredential.signalCurrentUserDetails) {
+      if (!rpId || !isValidBase64Url(userId)) {
+        console.warn(
+          'SignalCurrentUserDetails skipped: server rpId and valid unpadded Base64URL userId are required.'
+        );
+      } else {
+        try {
+          await PublicKeyCredential.signalCurrentUserDetails({
+            rpId, // Always use server-provided rpId; DO NOT use window.location.hostname
+            userId, // Base64URL-encoded user ID from the server
+            name: updatedName, // Updated username
+            displayName: updatedDisplayName, // Updated display name
+          });
+        } catch (e) {
+          // Use console.warn instead of console.error for passive background sync
+          console.warn('SignalCurrentUserDetails sync warning:', e);
+        }
+      }
+    }
+
+    const updatedListRes = await listFetch();
+    const { credentials, user } = await updatedListRes.json();
+    renderUI(credentials, user);
+    announceStatus(
+      'Profile updated and synchronized with your passkey provider.',
+      'success'
+    );
+  }
+}
+
+// Bind all interactive events in the "My Account" UI
+function setupEventListeners() {
+  // 1. Sign-in with passkey button
+  const passkeySignInBtn = document.getElementById('passkey-signin-btn');
+  if (passkeySignInBtn) {
+    passkeySignInBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
+      triggerButtonAuthentication();
+    });
+  }
+
+  // 2. Sign-in form submission (password login + automatic Conditional Create promotion)
+  const signInForm = document.getElementById('signin-form');
+  if (signInForm) {
+    signInForm.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
+      e.preventDefault();
+      const formData = new FormData(signInForm);
+      const username = String(formData.get('username') || '').trim();
+      const password = String(formData.get('password') || '');
+
+      if (!username) {
+        const userField = document.getElementById('signin-username');
+        if (userField) userField.focus();
+        return;
+      }
+
+      const res = await fetch('/api/login/password', {
+        method: 'POST',
+        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+        body: JSON.stringify({ username, password }),
+      });
+
+      if (res.ok) {
+        const data = await res.json();
+        await loadManagementPanel();
+        announceStatus(
+          `Signed in as ${data.user?.displayName || username}.`,
+          'success'
+        );
+        // Trigger silent Conditional Create right after a successful password sign-in
+        await triggerConditionalCreate();
+      }
+    });
+  }
+
+  // 3. Password visibility toggles
+  for (const toggleBtn of document.querySelectorAll('[data-password-toggle]')) {
+    toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
+      const targetId = toggleBtn.getAttribute('data-password-toggle');
+      const input = document.getElementById(targetId);
+      if (!input) return;
+      const isVisible = input.type === 'text';
+      input.type = isVisible ? 'password' : 'text';
+      toggleBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(!isVisible));
+      toggleBtn.textContent = isVisible ? 'Show' : 'Hide';
+    });
+  }
+
+  // 4. Customer Registration Form (with Passkey Registration)
+  const registerForm = document.getElementById('customer-register-form');
+  if (registerForm) {
+    registerForm.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
+      e.preventDefault();
+      const formData = new FormData(registerForm);
+      const displayName = String(formData.get('displayName') || '').trim();
+      const name = String(formData.get('email') || '').trim();
+      const favoriteRoast = String(formData.get('favoriteRoast') || 'Maple Oat Latte');
+
+      if (!name || !displayName) return;
+
+      await registerPasskey({
+        isPromotion: false,
+        name,
+        displayName,
+        nickname: `${displayName}'s Passkey`,
+      });
+      await performUserRename(name, displayName, { favoriteRoast });
+    });
+  }
+
+  // Dedicated "Register with Passkey" button inside customer registration card
+  const registerPasskeyBtn = document.getElementById('register-passkey-btn');
+  if (registerPasskeyBtn) {
+    registerPasskeyBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
+      const displayNameInput = document.getElementById('register-display-name');
+      const emailInput = document.getElementById('register-email');
+      const displayName = displayNameInput?.value.trim() || 'Alex Rivera';
+      const name = emailInput?.value.trim() || 'alex.rivera@dailygrind.coffee';
+      await registerPasskey({
+        isPromotion: false,
+        name,
+        displayName,
+      });
+    });
+  }
+
+  // 5. Management Panel: "Create passkey" button (omits authenticatorAttachment so security keys & platform passkeys work)
+  const createPasskeyBtn = document.getElementById('create-passkey-btn');
+  if (createPasskeyBtn) {
+    createPasskeyBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
+      await registerPasskey({ isPromotion: false });
+    });
+  }
+
+  // 6. Profile Update Form (synchronizes username & displayName via signalCurrentUserDetails)
+  const profileForm = document.getElementById('profile-update-form');
+  if (profileForm) {
+    profileForm.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
+      e.preventDefault();
+      const nameInput = document.getElementById('profile-username');
+      const displayInput = document.getElementById('profile-display-name');
+      const roastSelect = document.getElementById('profile-favorite-roast');
+
+      const updatedName = nameInput?.value.trim() || '';
+      const updatedDisplayName = displayInput?.value.trim() || '';
+      const favoriteRoast = roastSelect?.value || 'Maple Oat Latte';
+
+      if (!updatedName || !updatedDisplayName) {
+        if (!updatedDisplayName && displayInput) displayInput.focus();
+        else if (nameInput) nameInput.focus();
+        return;
+      }
+
+      await performUserRename(updatedName, updatedDisplayName, { favoriteRoast });
+    });
+  }
+
+  // 7. Reauthentication Button (Step-up verification for sensitive operations)
+  const reauthBtn = document.getElementById('reauth-btn');
+  if (reauthBtn) {
+    reauthBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
+      triggerButtonReauth();
+    });
+  }
+
+  // Sensitive actions gated behind step-up reauthentication
+  const updatePaymentBtn = document.getElementById('reauth-payment-btn');
+  if (updatePaymentBtn) {
+    updatePaymentBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
+      triggerButtonReauth(() => {
+        const msg = document.getElementById('reauth-result-message');
+        if (msg) {
+          msg.textContent =
+            'Identity confirmed via passkey! Default payment method (Visa •••• 4242) and auto-reload settings unlocked.';
+          msg.hidden = false;
+        }
+      });
+    });
+  }
+
+  // 8. Header "My Account" & "Order Now" Quick Sign-In (Immediate UI mode)
+  const quickSignInLinks = document.querySelectorAll('[data-quick-signin]');
+  for (const link of quickSignInLinks) {
+    link.addEventListener('click', async (event) => {
+      const accountSection = document.getElementById('my-account');
+      if (document.body.dataset.signedIn === 'true') {
+        if (accountSection) {
+          event.preventDefault();
+          accountSection.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
+        }
+        return;
+      }
+
+      event.preventDefault();
+      if (isAuthenticating) return;
+      isAuthenticating = true;
+      try {
+        const result = await authenticateWithImmediateUi();
+        document.body.dataset.signedIn = 'true';
+        await loadManagementPanel();
+        announceStatus(
+          `Quick sign-in complete! Welcome back, ${result.user?.displayName || 'Coffee Lover'}.`,
+          'success'
+        );
+        link.focus();
+      } catch (err) {
+        if (err.name === 'NotAllowedError') {
+          // Reveal fallback sign-in UI and move focus to first interactive control
+          if (accountSection) {
+            accountSection.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
+          }
+          const firstInput = document.getElementById('signin-username');
+          if (firstInput) firstInput.focus();
+          announceStatus(
+            'Sign in below with your passkey or password to access your Daily Grind account.',
+            'info'
+          );
+          return;
+        }
+        console.warn('Quick sign-in error:', err);
+      } finally {
+        isAuthenticating = false;
+      }
+    });
+  }
+
+  // 9. Logout Link
+  const logoutLink = document.getElementById('logout-link');
+  if (logoutLink) {
+    logoutLink.addEventListener('click', async (event) => {
+      event.preventDefault();
+      await fetch('/api/logout', { method: 'POST' });
+      document.body.dataset.signedIn = 'false';
+      announceStatus('You have signed out. Use a passkey to sign back in anytime.', 'info');
+      const firstInput = document.getElementById('signin-username');
+      if (firstInput) firstInput.focus();
+    });
+  }
+}
+
+// Initialize on DOMContentLoaded
+window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', async () => {
+  setupEventListeners();
+  await gatePasskeyUiOnLoad();
+  await loadManagementPanel();
+  await initializeConditionalAutofill();
+});

Visual Font Height Normalization

+

Normalizing x-height metrics across mixed typefaces and independent theme containers using modern CSS.

+
+ +
+

Mixed Fonts Container

+

+ When mixing proportional prose with inline code snippets like font-size-adjust: from-font or calling functions such as document.querySelector('#mixed-fonts-container'), differences in lowercase x-height between serif, sans-serif, and monospace families can make inline code appear disproportionately large or small. +

+

+ By applying font-size-adjust: from-font on this container, the browser automatically extracts the primary font's x-height aspect ratio and scales nested <code>, <kbd>, and <samp> elements (such as npm run build or const ratio = 0.52;) so their lowercase visual height matches seamlessly without layout shifts. +

+
+ +
+

Independent Theme Container

+

+ This separate container represents an independent editorial theme using a traditional serif typeface stack. Because it is not nested inside the primary font context from which it wants to derive its visual proportions, it applies an explicit numeric metric override (font-size-adjust: 0.52) to lock down its lowercase x-height ratio directly. +

+

+ Even if the active font swaps across fallback families or themes, locking the aspect ratio to 0.52 guarantees consistent visual height and readability across the interface. +

+
+
